How to write to here, after the last two semesters? These two were the semesters of the first year we have ever been in Bilkent. From me not knowing how to do assignments to managing to do a whole group work, from the whole 200-per-week(Which I always completed.) to the out-of-100, it was a year filled with finding how to do the best we could. The moment I was saved from doing group work with a bad group. The moment I had a grade right before the closest holiday to the end of the first semester. The moment I stopped sitting against the cancellations at a class all alone. The moment I started my journey into learning what I need for my future. All of these were parts of it. I honestly have no idea how I would be if I didn't have the chance to have 115 and 116 this year. Maybe, I would never learn how to be a great student at all. Maybe issues at the end of the first semester would never be as clear as they were. Of course, all of these were just parts of a connection between a new student and a new professor. But it was the best possible. Or, is it still the best possible?(I know the answer, but can't tell.) To anyone reading this, please read the other evaluations too, as this is supposed to mean nothing to you. Because nothing I mentioned happened inside of the class. Dear Britain Webb Hopkins… She is the most understanding, well-intentioned and supportive proffessor in the world. Being her student and participating in her class is a honour. I am really glad that this department has such a lovely, brilliant and kind proffessor. I wish I could take all of my courses from her. It was really easy to follow all the classes and her teaching style is so remarkable and catching. I am so appreciated being in this class.

First and foremost, it is almost impossible to get bored of her teaching. She possesses a strong understanding of what it is like to be an undergrad student, and therefore almost and always finds different ways to make sure she can help her students. She does not forget her students are human beings as well and thus understands the mistakes they could make. She understands the most important asset she could offer to a classroom is her ability to making sure we understand the class material in parallel to the contemporary times, and therefore mostly connects class materials to recent discussions we have across the globe. I loved our discussions on Ayn Rand and Malcom X, for instance, because most of our discussions could be easily linked with contemporary times, and therefore allowed me to have a better grasp at understanding the class material. She is an incredibly kind person, and I found her teaching much more easier to understand compared to my previous experience of studying American Intellectual History I from a different instructor. On top of that, I also observed how class was more willing to contribute because none of us was being forced to act in a specific direction. Her approach to the exams was very straightforward as we were given rubrics before the exams and therefore we were able to prepare in a way that could potentially match with what would be coming up on the exam. Most of the time the exams were forcing us to get creative because there was not simply a correct answer but whatever we are going to say had to be linked with an evidence from the text. Lastly, I could say those who followed up in class discussions and read the material before the classes ended up getting the best grades possible. So this is still mostly a hard class, but if you are willing to listen to whatever she talks about in class and follow up with the text, you will surely have so much fun.

Strongest point:
Stating what is a good response and what is not, leaving little room for confusion.

Weakest point:
Too much homework. Heavy texts of around 20 (sometimes over 30) pages and reading responses every week. Deadline for reading responses are strictly at Friday midnight, leaving little to no free time in the weekdays. Critical reflections are about 1000 words however the fact that these are heavy texts, even if the answer is rushed it requires 7+ hours to complete one (time spent thinking about the contents not included). All day every day I think about this class and what I will write for the next assignment. No other class requires this much mental energy. The final for this class requires group work. If one makes a mistake all group members are affected, apart from checking your work, you are obligated to check all your group members work as well. This is the 6th day I've been working on the final and I am still not halfway. Any other class requires 1,5 to 3 hours for their finals. This amount of workload is not natural. This class alone makes me feel like a student studying for YKS aiming for top 10.

Hiçbir ödevi kesinlikle beğenmiyor puanlarını her zaman kırıyor ödev sonlarına not olarak kısa eklemeler yapıp ödeve direkt 10 üzerinden 1-3 arası puan veriyor.Sırf alıntıların istediği formatta olmamasından dolayı 10 puanlık ödevden 7-8 puan kırıyor.Örneğin Moodle'da verdiği ikinci critical reflection ödevlerinin içeriğinde iki kaynak arasından birini seçmemiz gerektiği yazarken ödev değerlendirmesinde bu kaynağı neden seçtiğimizi açıklamadığımdan dolayı hatalı ödev olduğunu söylüyor ama bu kaynağı neden seçtiğimizi açıklamamızı istediğini ödev pdf dosyasının içinde bulundurmuyor.Aynı ödevle ilgili olarak yine ödev dosyasının içinde bulunmayan bir kaynağa değinmediğimden dolayı (Palczewski et al and Kuypers and King) dolayı hata yaptığımı söylüyor fakat ödev pdf dosyasında bu metni kullanmamızı söyleyen bir yönergeyi geçtim bu kaynağın adı bile geçmiyor.Bu ödevden 1.00 ve D alırken ilk ödevimden de yanlış format ve bunun gibi benzeri hatalardan dolayı 1.30 aldım.Ödevlerimde bulunan tanımlamaların hepsinin doğru olmasına rağmen format ve alıntı hatalarından dolayı 9 puan kırmasından dolayı bu dersi önümüzdeki dönem tekrardan almam gerekecek ve ilk dönemimde ortalamamı etkileyecek.Hiçbir şekilde içeriğin doğru olup olmadığını göz önünde bulundurmaksızın tek yanlıştan ödevin yarısı direkt hiçe gitmiş oluyor.
Olumlu yanı ise bir keresinde hasta olmamdan dolayı dersten erken çıkmama izin vermişti bu kadar.
course: Professor Hopkins is extremely qualified. Her class was the only one where I knew I would learn a lot from in every single lesson. Her communication with students is respectful and academic. However, the final of this class being a group project causes issues to rise. Normally, with group projects it's not unusual that some people would work less than others. But when the case is something that is worth %35 of our grade, a person that cares about getting a good grade and submitting a nuanced work has to bear the burden that is the inadequate work of the people that only care about passing the class with whatever grade. They end up having to work overtime to compensate for their group members' insufficiency. In that light I find it unfair that the final of our class was prompted to be done as a group. Despite that, Professor Hopkins is my most appreciated Professor.
